g.title: crate A render engine of its own device that shares frames with Arvane, for tests.
crate::adapters Lists this machine's hardware adapters of a backend, for window-less tests.
crate::d3d12 The test engine on its own Direct3D 12 device, drawing into a shared pool.
crate::engine What the backends' engines do, and the pool's constants.
crate::pattern The known picture of each frame and its check against shown pixels.
crate::producer Producer: runs a backend engine for an adapter and draws pattern frames.
crate::vulkan The test engine on its own Vulkan device, drawing into a shared pool.
crate::wgpu_engine The test engine on Kivact's wgpu, drawing into a shared pool.
